description: 0xSero's DeepSeek V4 Flash REAP 180B (K160, 160 experts per layer, MXFP4, about 103 GB) on one Spark with vLLM, from 0xSero/deepseek-spark at 97fd6f02 (runtime/ configs and launcher; the vLLM Studio controller in the same repository is not packaged). Runs on upstream's public arm64 cutlass451-g27 vLLM image (pinned by digest) with upstream's GB10 REAP patcher applied at build time instead of at each start: router fallback for non-standard expert counts, per-layer MXFP4 memory hygiene, CUDA-IPC fix. 200000-token context, FP8 KV cache (fixed KV budget), one sequence, thinking on by default, DeepSeek V4 tokenizer, tool-call and reasoning parsers, CUDA graphs (FULL_AND_PIECEWISE), prefix caching. DeepSeek MTP speculation with 2 draft tokens is on (the k160-mtp2-200k profile, the upstream default; upstream also has a no-speculation k160 profile with a larger KV budget that is not packaged, since an option cannot remove the speculative config). Upstream claims, not measured here: model load 96.66 GiB, 537516 KV tokens, about 33 tok/s median decode and 550 tok/s prefill on a 136k prompt with MTP acceptance about 70 percent. Licences are informational: weights repository and DeepSeek V4 are MIT; the source repository carries no licence file. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.88 beside the fixed 6G FP8 KV pool, as in 0xSero's runtime/configs/k160-mtp2-200k.env at 97fd6f02 (lines 6 and 9); with a fixed pool the utilization is vLLM's startup free-memory check. The declared peak, 120,370,379,081 bytes, covers the weights, the pool and 8 GB of runtime overhead (117,550,032,960 bytes); upstream measured 96.66 GiB of model memory and a 537,516-token KV pool at these settings; the reserve is 8 GB, and admission keeps the platform memory floor free beside the peak.
title: DeepSeek V4 Flash REAP 180B (K160) MTP vLLM single Spark (0xSero)
